activation.reason:
Starting [systemd-run] /run/current-system/sw/bin/bash -c "set -u -o pipefail
sys="\$1"
revision="\$2"
repo_root="\$3"
machine="\$4"
receipt_root="\$5"
previous="\$(readlink -f /run/current-system)"
transaction="\$(date +%s%N)-\${revision:0:12}"
state_prefix="/run/\${machine}-activate-\${transaction}"
before_failed="\${state_prefix}.before"
after_failed="\${state_prefix}.after"
changed_system="\${state_prefix}.changed-system"
changed_user="\${state_prefix}.changed-user"
reconciled_system="\${state_prefix}.reconciled-system"
reconciled_user="\${state_prefix}.reconciled-user"
restarted_system="\${state_prefix}.restarted-system"
restarted_user="\${state_prefix}.restarted-user"
retained_system="\${state_prefix}.retained-system"
retained_user="\${state_prefix}.retained-user"
retained_system_pids_before="\${state_prefix}.retained-system-pids-before"
retained_user_pids_before="\${state_prefix}.retained-user-pids-before"
retained_system_pids_after="\${state_prefix}.retained-system-pids-after"
retained_user_pids_after="\${state_prefix}.retained-user-pids-after"
retention_violations="\${state_prefix}.retention-violations"
overridden_system="\${state_prefix}.overridden-system"
overridden_user="\${state_prefix}.overridden-user"
planned_runtime="\${state_prefix}.planned-runtime"
cleared_runtime="\${state_prefix}.cleared-runtime"
restored_runtime="\${state_prefix}.restored-runtime"
health_passed="\${state_prefix}.health-passed"
health_failed="\${state_prefix}.health-failed"
health_skipped="\${state_prefix}.health-skipped"
new_failed_units="\${state_prefix}.new-failed-units"
persistent_conflicts="\${state_prefix}.persistent-conflicts"
runtime_snapshot="\${state_prefix}.runtime-snapshot"
runtime_reconciled=false
activation_mutated=false
git_bin="\$previous/sw/bin/git"
nix_env="\$previous/sw/bin/nix-env"
python_bin="\$previous/sw/bin/python3"
sudo_bin=/run/wrappers/bin/sudo
deployment_lock="/run/lock/\${machine}-deployment.lock"
exec 9>"\$deployment_lock"
if ! "\$previous/sw/bin/flock" --nonblock 9; then
    echo "another \$machine deployment transaction owns \$deployment_lock" >&2
    exit 75
fi

cleanup() {
    rm -f "\$before_failed" "\${before_failed}.raw" "\$after_failed" \
        "\$changed_system" "\$changed_user" \
        "\${changed_system}.candidates" "\${changed_user}.candidates" \
        "\$reconciled_system" "\$reconciled_user" \
        "\$restarted_system" "\$restarted_user" \
        "\$retained_system" "\$retained_user" \
        "\$retained_system_pids_before" "\$retained_user_pids_before" \
        "\$retained_system_pids_after" "\$retained_user_pids_after" \
        "\$retention_violations" \
        "\${retained_system}.tmp" "\${retained_user}.tmp" \
        "\${retained_system_pids_before}.tmp" \
        "\${retained_user_pids_before}.tmp" \
        "\$overridden_system" "\$overridden_user" \
        "\$planned_runtime" "\$cleared_runtime" "\$restored_runtime" \
        "\$health_passed" "\$health_failed" "\$health_skipped" \
        "\$new_failed_units" "\$persistent_conflicts" \
        "\${persistent_conflicts}.system-units" \
        "\${persistent_conflicts}.user-units"
    rm -rf -- "\$runtime_snapshot"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

for state_file in \
        "\$reconciled_system" "\$reconciled_user" \
        "\$restarted_system" "\$restarted_user" \
        "\$retained_system" "\$retained_user" \
        "\$retained_system_pids_before" "\$retained_user_pids_before" \
        "\$retained_system_pids_after" "\$retained_user_pids_after" \
        "\$retention_violations" \
        "\$overridden_system" "\$overridden_user" \
        "\$changed_system" "\$changed_user" \
        "\$planned_runtime" "\$cleared_runtime" "\$restored_runtime" \
        "\$health_passed" "\$health_failed" "\$health_skipped" \
        "\$new_failed_units" "\$persistent_conflicts"; do
    if ! : >"\$state_file"; then
        echo "could not initialize activation state \$state_file" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

user_systemctl() {
    "\$sudo_bin" -u draven -- "\$previous/sw/bin/env" \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 \
        "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" --user "\$@"
}

unit_name_supported() {
    case "\$1" in
        *.service|*.socket|*.device|*.mount|*.automount|*.swap|*.target|*.path|*.timer|*.slice|*.scope)
            return 0
            ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

list_changed_units() {
    local current_units="\$1"
    local candidate_units="\$2"
    local output="\$3"
    local entry unit
    local candidates="\${output}.candidates"
    : >"\$candidates" || return 1

    for entry in "\$current_units"/* "\$candidate_units"/*; do
        [ -e "\$entry" ] || [ -L "\$entry" ] || continue
        unit="\${entry##*/}"
        unit_name_supported "\$unit" || continue
        printf '%s\n' "\$unit" >>"\$candidates" || return 1
    done
    sort -u "\$candidates" -o "\$candidates" || return 1
    : >"\$output" || return 1
    while IFS= read -r unit; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        if { ! [ -e "\$current_units/\$unit" ] && ! [ -L "\$current_units/\$unit" ]; } \
            || { ! [ -e "\$candidate_units/\$unit" ] && ! [ -L "\$candidate_units/\$unit" ]; } \
            || ! "\$previous/sw/bin/cmp" -s \
                "\$current_units/\$unit" "\$candidate_units/\$unit"; then
            printf '%s\n' "\$unit" >>"\$output" || return 1
        fi
    done <"\$candidates"
    rm -f "\$candidates"
}

check_failed_unit_baseline() {
    local raw="\${before_failed}.raw" unit fragment blocked=false
    if ! "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" --failed --no-legend --no-pager --plain >"\$raw"; then
        echo "refusing activation: could not inspect failed units" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    awk '{print \$1}' "\$raw" | sort -u >"\$before_failed" || return 1
    while IFS= read -r unit; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        # A candidate may repair or remove a failed unit it changes. An
        # unrelated failure must be repaired before a system-wide switch:
        # NixOS retries failed units and reports any failure as switch failure.
        if grep -Fxq -- "\$unit" "\$changed_system"; then
            continue
        fi
        # systemctl lists instances, while the unit diff lists templates.
        # Consult the loaded fragment rather than assuming every @ instance
        # uses its template (an explicit instance definition can override it).
        if fragment="\$("\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" show "\$unit" --property=FragmentPath --value)" \
            && [ -n "\$fragment" ] \
            && grep -Fxq -- "\${fragment##*/}" "\$changed_system"; then
            continue
        fi
        echo "refusing activation: unchanged unit is already failed: \$unit" >&2
        blocked=true
    done <"\$before_failed"
    [ "\$blocked" = false ]
}

list_transaction_units() {
    local changed_units="\$1"
    local managed_units="\$2"
    local output="\$3"
    local marker unit

    if ! cp "\$changed_units" "\$output"; then
        return 1
    fi
    for marker in "\$managed_units"/*; do
        [ -e "\$marker" ] || [ -L "\$marker" ] || continue
        unit="\${marker##*/}"
        unit_name_supported "\$unit" || continue
        printf '%s\n' "\$unit" >>"\$output" || return 1
    done
    sort -u "\$output" -o "\$output"
}

record_persistent_conflict() {
    local conflict="\$1"
    if ! grep -Fqx "\$conflict" "\$persistent_conflicts"; then
        printf '%s\n' "\$conflict" >>"\$persistent_conflicts" || return 1
    fi
}

check_declarative_unit_root() {
    local mounted_root="\$1"
    local declarative_root="\$2"
    local mounted_resolved declarative_resolved

    mounted_resolved="\$(readlink -f -- "\$mounted_root")" || return 1
    declarative_resolved="\$(readlink -f -- "\$declarative_root")" || return 1
    if [ "\$mounted_resolved" != "\$declarative_resolved" ]; then
        echo "persistent unit root conflicts with the active declarative closure: \$mounted_root -> \$mounted_resolved" >&2
        record_persistent_conflict \
            "\$mounted_root -> \$mounted_resolved (expected \$declarative_resolved)"
    fi
}

check_persistent_unit_overrides() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local units_file="\$2"
    shift 2
    local root unit entry suffix

    while IFS= read -r unit; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        for root in "\$@"; do
            for suffix in "" .d; do
                entry="\$root/\$unit\$suffix"
                if [ -e "\$entry" ] || [ -L "\$entry" ]; then
                    echo "persistent \$scope unit override conflicts with this transaction: \$entry" >&2
                    record_persistent_conflict "\$entry" || return 1
                fi
            done
        done
    done <"\$units_file"
}

check_all_persistent_overrides() {
    local transaction_system="\${persistent_conflicts}.system-units"
    local transaction_user="\${persistent_conflicts}.user-units"
    local result

    list_transaction_units "\$changed_system" \
        "\$sys/etc/columbus-deployment/managed-system-units" \
        "\$transaction_system" \
    && list_transaction_units "\$changed_user" \
        "\$sys/etc/columbus-deployment/managed-user-units" \
        "\$transaction_user" \
    && check_declarative_unit_root /etc/systemd/system \
        "\$previous/etc/systemd/system" \
    && check_declarative_unit_root /etc/systemd/user \
        "\$previous/etc/systemd/user" \
    && check_persistent_unit_overrides system "\$transaction_system" \
        /etc/systemd/system.control /etc/systemd/system.attached \
    && check_persistent_unit_overrides user "\$transaction_user" \
        /home/draven/.config/systemd/user.control \
        /home/draven/.config/systemd/user \
        /home/draven/.config/systemd/user.attached
    result=\$?
    rm -f "\$transaction_system" "\$transaction_user"
    return "\$result"
}

runtime_entry_owned() {
    local runtime_entry="\$1"
    local current_units="\$2"
    local candidate_units="\$3"
    local managed_units="\$4"

    owned_unit="\${runtime_entry##*/}"
    owned_unit="\${owned_unit%.d}"
    unit_name_supported "\$owned_unit" || return 1

    owned_current_exists=false
    if [ -e "\$current_units/\$owned_unit" ] \
        || [ -L "\$current_units/\$owned_unit" ]; then
        owned_current_exists=true
    fi
    owned_candidate_exists=false
    if [ -e "\$candidate_units/\$owned_unit" ] \
        || [ -L "\$candidate_units/\$owned_unit" ]; then
        owned_candidate_exists=true
    fi
    if [ "\$owned_current_exists" = false ] \
        && [ "\$owned_candidate_exists" = false ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    owned_declarative_changed=true
    if [ "\$owned_current_exists" = true ] \
        && [ "\$owned_candidate_exists" = true ] \
        && "\$previous/sw/bin/cmp" -s \
            "\$current_units/\$owned_unit" "\$candidate_units/\$owned_unit"; then
        owned_declarative_changed=false
    fi
    if [ "\$owned_declarative_changed" = false ] \
        && ! [ -e "\$managed_units/\$owned_unit" ] \
        && ! [ -L "\$managed_units/\$owned_unit" ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

runtime_entry_matches_kind() {
    local runtime_entry="\$1"
    local override_kind="\$2"
    case "\$override_kind:\$runtime_entry" in
        dropin:*.d) return 0 ;;
        transient:*.d|runtime-unit:*.d) return 1 ;;
        transient:*|runtime-unit:*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

runtime_entry_requires_reconcile() {
    local runtime_entry="\$1"
    local current_units="\$2"
    local candidate_units="\$3"
    local managed_units="\$4"
    local override_kind="\$5"

    runtime_entry_matches_kind "\$runtime_entry" "\$override_kind" || return 1
    runtime_entry_owned "\$runtime_entry" \
        "\$current_units" "\$candidate_units" "\$managed_units" || return 1
    # /etc/systemd/{system,user} outranks ordinary unit files below /run.
    # Such a runtime unit is harmless while the candidate still declares the
    # same unit, but it must be removed when the candidate removes that unit.
    if [ "\$override_kind" = runtime-unit ] \
        && [ "\$owned_candidate_exists" = true ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

candidate_retains_active_process() {
    local candidate_units="\$1"
    local unit="\$2"
    local candidate_unit="\$candidate_units/\$unit"
    case "\$unit" in
        *.service) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    [ -f "\$candidate_unit" ] \
        && grep -Fqx 'X-RestartIfChanged=false' "\$candidate_unit" \
        && grep -Fqx 'X-StopIfChanged=false' "\$candidate_unit"
}

record_retained_process() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local unit="\$2"
    local retained_file="\$3"
    local retained_pids_file="\$4"
    local pid

    if grep -Fqx "\$unit" "\$retained_file"; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
        pid="\$("\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" show "\$unit" \
            --property MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    else
        pid="\$(user_systemctl show "\$unit" \
            --property MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    fi
    case "\$pid" in
        ''|0|*[!0-9]*)
            echo "could not snapshot live PID for retained \$scope unit \$unit" >&2
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\n' "\$unit" >>"\$retained_file" \
        && printf '%s\t%s\n' "\$unit" "\$pid" >>"\$retained_pids_file"
}

snapshot_retained_processes() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local changed_units="\$2"
    local candidate_units="\$3"
    local retained_file="\$4"
    local retained_pids_file="\$5"
    local unit

    while IFS= read -r unit; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        candidate_retains_active_process "\$candidate_units" "\$unit" \
            || continue
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" is-active --quiet "\$unit" \
                || continue
        else
            user_systemctl is-active --quiet "\$unit" || continue
        fi
        record_retained_process "\$scope" "\$unit" \
            "\$retained_file" "\$retained_pids_file" || return 1
    done <"\$changed_units"
}

forget_retained_unit() {
    local unit="\$1"
    local retained_file="\$2"
    local retained_pids_file="\$3"
    local temporary="\${retained_file}.tmp"
    local pids_temporary="\${retained_pids_file}.tmp"
    local retained_unit retained_pid
    : >"\$temporary" || return 1
    while IFS= read -r retained_unit; do
        [ "\$retained_unit" = "\$unit" ] \
            || printf '%s\n' "\$retained_unit" >>"\$temporary" \
            || return 1
    done <"\$retained_file"
    if ! mv -f "\$temporary" "\$retained_file" \
        || ! : >"\$pids_temporary"; then
        return 1
    fi
    while IFS=\$'\t' read -r retained_unit retained_pid; do
        [ "\$retained_unit" = "\$unit" ] \
            || printf '%s\t%s\n' "\$retained_unit" "\$retained_pid" \
                >>"\$pids_temporary" \
            || return 1
    done <"\$retained_pids_file"
    mv -f "\$pids_temporary" "\$retained_pids_file"
}

verify_retained_processes() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local retained_file="\$2"
    local retained_pids_before="\$3"
    local retained_pids_after="\$4"
    local unit before_pid after_pid
    local failed=false

    while IFS= read -r unit; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        before_pid="\$(awk -F '\t' -v unit="\$unit" \
            '\$1 == unit { print \$2; exit }' "\$retained_pids_before")"
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            after_pid="\$("\$sys/sw/bin/systemctl" show "\$unit" \
                --property MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)" || after_pid=unavailable
        else
            after_pid="\$(user_systemctl show "\$unit" \
                --property MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)" || after_pid=unavailable
        fi
        printf '%s\t%s\n' "\$unit" "\$after_pid" >>"\$retained_pids_after" \
            || return 1
        if [ -z "\$before_pid" ] || [ "\$after_pid" != "\$before_pid" ]; then
            printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
                "\$scope" "\$unit" "\${before_pid:-unavailable}" "\$after_pid" \
                >>"\$retention_violations" || return 1
            echo "retained \$scope unit \$unit changed PID from \${before_pid:-unavailable} to \$after_pid" >&2
            failed=true
        fi
    done <"\$retained_file"
    [ "\$failed" = false ]
}

verify_all_retained_processes() {
    local failed=false
    : >"\$retained_system_pids_after" \
        && : >"\$retained_user_pids_after" \
        && : >"\$retention_violations" \
        || return 1
    verify_retained_processes system "\$retained_system" \
        "\$retained_system_pids_before" "\$retained_system_pids_after" \
        || failed=true
    verify_retained_processes user "\$retained_user" \
        "\$retained_user_pids_before" "\$retained_user_pids_after" \
        || failed=true
    [ "\$failed" = false ]
}

restart_retention_violations_after_rollback() {
    local scope unit before_pid after_pid
    local failed=false

    while IFS=\$'\t' read -r scope unit before_pid after_pid; do
        [ -n "\$unit" ] || continue
        echo "restarting \$scope unit \$unit after retained PID changed from \$before_pid to \$after_pid" >&2
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" restart "\$unit" || failed=true
        else
            user_systemctl restart "\$unit" || failed=true
        fi
    done <"\$retention_violations"
    [ "\$failed" = false ]
}

snapshot_runtime_overrides() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local runtime_root="\$2"
    local current_units="\$3"
    local candidate_units="\$4"
    local managed_units="\$5"
    local snapshot_root="\$6"
    local active_file="\$7"
    local override_kind="\$8"
    local runtime_entry snapshot_entry
    [ -d "\$runtime_root" ] || return 0
    mkdir -p "\$snapshot_root" || return 1

    for runtime_entry in "\$runtime_root"/*; do
        [ -e "\$runtime_entry" ] || [ -L "\$runtime_entry" ] || continue
        if ! runtime_entry_requires_reconcile "\$runtime_entry" \
            "\$current_units" "\$candidate_units" "\$managed_units" \
            "\$override_kind"; then
            continue
        fi
        snapshot_entry="\$snapshot_root/\${runtime_entry##*/}"
        if ! [ -e "\$snapshot_entry" ] && ! [ -L "\$snapshot_entry" ]; then
            "\$previous/sw/bin/cp" -a -- "\$runtime_entry" "\$snapshot_entry" \
                || return 1
        fi
        if ! grep -Fqx "\$runtime_entry" "\$planned_runtime"; then
            printf '%s\n' "\$runtime_entry" >>"\$planned_runtime" || return 1
        fi
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            if "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" is-active --quiet "\$owned_unit" \
                && ! grep -Fqx "\$owned_unit" "\$active_file"; then
                printf '%s\n' "\$owned_unit" >>"\$active_file"
            fi
        elif user_systemctl is-active --quiet "\$owned_unit" \
            && ! grep -Fqx "\$owned_unit" "\$active_file"; then
            printf '%s\n' "\$owned_unit" >>"\$active_file"
        fi
    done
}

reconcile_runtime_overrides() {
    local scope="\$1"
    local runtime_root="\$2"
    local current_units="\$3"
    local candidate_units="\$4"
    local managed_units="\$5"
    local restart_file="\$6"
    local override_kind="\$7"
    local restart_changed="\$8"
    local runtime_entry unit declarative_changed candidate_exists was_active
    local retain_active retained_file retained_pids_file
    [ -d "\$runtime_root" ] || return 0

    for runtime_entry in "\$runtime_root"/*; do
        [ -e "\$runtime_entry" ] || [ -L "\$runtime_entry" ] || continue
        if ! runtime_entry_requires_reconcile "\$runtime_entry" \
            "\$current_units" "\$candidate_units" "\$managed_units" \
            "\$override_kind"; then
            continue
        fi
        unit="\$owned_unit"
        declarative_changed="\$owned_declarative_changed"
        candidate_exists="\$owned_candidate_exists"
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            retained_file="\$retained_system"
            retained_pids_file="\$retained_system_pids_before"
        else
            retained_file="\$retained_user"
            retained_pids_file="\$retained_user_pids_before"
        fi

        echo "reconciling runtime override for transaction-owned \$scope unit \$unit"
        was_active=false
        if [ "\$scope" = system ]; then
            if "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" is-active --quiet "\$unit"; then
                was_active=true
            fi
            if [ "\$override_kind" != dropin ]; then
                "\$previous/sw/bin/systemctl" stop "\$unit" || return 1
            fi
        else
            if user_systemctl is-active --quiet "\$unit"; then
                was_active=true
            fi
            if [ "\$override_kind" != dropin ]; then
                user_systemctl stop "\$unit" || return 1
            fi
        fi
        retain_active=false
        if [ "\$candidate_exists" = true ] \
            && [ "\$was_active" = true ] \
            && [ "\$override_kind" = dropin ] \
            && candidate_retains_active_process "\$candidate_units" "\$unit"; then
            retain_active=true
            if ! grep -Fqx "\$unit" "\$restart_file"; then
                record_retained_process "\$scope" "\$unit" \
                    "\$retained_file" "\$retained_pids_file" || return 1
            fi
        fi
        # Delete only the entry that was classified, snapshotted, and claimed
        # by this transaction. systemctl revert is intentionally forbidden:
        # it also deletes persistent overrides outside the /run snapshot.
        rm -rf -- "\$runtime_entry" || return 1
        printf '%s\n' "\$runtime_entry" >>"\$cleared_runtime" || return 1
        if [ "\$candidate_exists" = true ] \
            && [ "\$was_active" = true ] \
            && { [ "\$restart_changed" = true ] \
                || [ "\$declarative_changed" = false ] \
                || [ "\$override_kind" != dropin ]; } \
            && [ "\$retain_active" = false ]; then
            forget_retained_unit "\$unit" "\$retained_file" \
                "\$retained_pids_file" || return 1
            if ! grep -Fqx "\$unit" "\$restart_file"; then
                printf '%s\n' "\$unit" >>"\$restart_file" || return 1
            fi
        fi
    done
}

assert_no_runtime_overrides() {
    local runtime_root="\$1"
    local current_units="\$2"
    local candidate_units="\$3"
    local managed_units="\$4"
    local override_kind="\$5"
    local runtime_entry
    [ -d "\$runtime_root" ] || return 0
    for runtime_entry in "\$runtime_root"/*; do
        [ -e "\$runtime_entry" ] || [ -L "\$runtime_entry" ] || continue
        if runtime_entry_requires_reconcile "\$runtime_entry" \
            "\$current_units" "\$candidate_units" "\$managed_units" \
            "\$override_kind"; then
            echo "runtime override reappeared for transaction-owned unit \$owned_unit" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    done
}

restore_runtime_root() {
    local runtime_root="\$1"
    local snapshot_root="\$2"
    local snapshot_entry target
    [ -d "\$snapshot_root" ] || return 0
    mkdir -p "\$runtime_root" || return 1
    for snapshot_entry in "\$snapshot_root"/*; do
        [ -e "\$snapshot_entry" ] || [ -L "\$snapshot_entry" ] || continue
        target="\$runtime_root/\${snapshot_entry##*/}"
        if [ -e "\$target" ] || [ -L "\$target" ]; then
            rm -rf -- "\$target" || return 1
        fi
        "\$previous/sw/bin/cp" -a -- "\$snapshot_entry" "\$target" || return 1
        printf '%s\n' "\$target" >>"\$restored_runtime" || return 1
    done
}
